what: Build packed .pak data for a project: -wbModule=ResourceManager -buildData <platform> <outDir> -gproj <gproj> (unresolved: the -buildData plus -gproj form is unmeasured, DEC-047 L7).

label: wb_census
what: Query the census ledger: what a Workbench or game surface is and where it lives.

label: wb_cleanup
what: Remove the temporary EnfusionMCP handler scripts from a mod's directory.

label: wb_clipboard
what: Clipboard operations in the World Editor.

label: wb_component
what: Manage components on an entity in the World Editor.

label: wb_connect
what: Test the connection to Arma Reforger Workbench.

label: wb_diagnose
what: Diagnose the EnfusionMCP to Workbench connection when wb_launch fails or wb_connect errors.

label: wb_entity_create
what: Create a new entity in the World Editor from a prefab.

label: wb_entity_delete
what: Delete an entity from the World Editor by name.

label: wb_entity_duplicate
what: Duplicate a scene entity (including locked base-game prefab instances) into your mod folder, assigning it a new resource GUID.

label: wb_entity_inspect
what: Get detailed information about a specific entity, including its components, properties, position, and children.

label: wb_entity_list
what: List entities in the current world.

label: wb_entity_modify
what: Modify an entity in the World Editor.

label: wb_entity_select
what: Manage entity selection in the World Editor.

label: wb_execute_action
what: Execute any Workbench menu action by its menu path.

label: wb_gui
what: Workbench GUI through UI Automation (opt-in: ENFUSION_GUI=1; Windows).

label: wb_knowledge
what: Search the Arma Reforger modding knowledge base — distilled pattern files covering scripting, audio, weapons, vehicles, AI, UI, game modes, animation, and all other modding domains.

label: wb_launch
what: Launch Arma Reforger Workbench (Arma Reforger Tools).

label: wb_layers
what: Query layers in the World Editor.

label: wb_localization
what: Manage localization entries in the Workbench Localization Editor.

label: wb_open_resource
what: Alias of wb_module setResource on the World Editor: opens a project-relative resource.

label: wb_play
what: Switch Workbench to game (play) mode.

label: wb_prefabs
what: Prefab operations in the Workbench.

label: wb_projects
what: Query project information from the Workbench.

label: wb_reload
what: Alias of wb_scripts reload: ReloadScripts, then a re-ping.

label: wb_resources
what: Manage Workbench resources.

label: wb_save
what: Alias of wb_module save on the World Editor.

label: wb_script_editor
what: Interact with the Workbench Script Editor.

label: wb_scripts
what: Script compile train through Workbench's natives.

label: wb_state
what: Get a full snapshot of the current Workbench state.

label: wb_stop
what: Stop game mode and return to the World Editor.

label: wb_terrain
what: Query terrain information.

label: wb_undo_redo
what: Undo or redo the last action in the World Editor.

label: wb_validate
what: Run the Workbench's built-in validators on a material or texture resource.

label: wb_validate_scripts
what: Alias of wb_scripts validate: ValidateScripts through the running Workbench.

label: weapon_pose_lint
what: String-level check of a character `.agr` (Animation Graph Runtime) file against the expected `GlobalTags { "WEAPON" "ADS" "STANCE" ... }` block.

label: wiki_read
what: Read the full content of a specific wiki page by title.

label: wiki_search
what: Search pre-downloaded Bohemia Interactive Wiki (BIKI) content, tutorials, and guides about Enfusion engine concepts, scripting patterns, and Arma Reforger modding topics.

label: workshop_check_deps
what: Read a `.gproj` from disk, extract its Dependencies block, and resolve each dep GUID the way WORKBENCH does: against the Workbench addons dir, the folders next to the project, and the base game + Tools installs.

label: workshop_info
what: Read Workshop metadata from a mod's .gproj file.

label: workshop_validate_manifest
what: Pre-flight a `.gproj` against Workshop publish constraints — required fields, length limits, preview/screenshot size caps, dependency well-formedness, and dev-handler leak guard.

label: world_compose_summary
what: Produce a static markdown summary of a `.ent` world file — total entity count, top entity classes by count, SubScene parent references (worlds that wrap another world via `SubScene { Parent "{GUID}path" }`), sibling `*_Layers/*.layer` file count, and a best-effort XYZ bounding box from any positional properties found.

label: world_diff
what: Semantic diff between two Enfusion text files (typically `.ent` worlds or `.layer` files).

label: world_validate_refs
what: File-scoped variant of `find_broken_refs`.
